reviews.text:
Healingo. I am very disappointed with the app

For me it is ineffective. So I attempted to cancel on the last day of the extremely short trial period, (3 days is not long enough to properly evaluate an app with such a nebulously subjective experience in my opinion.)

I was unable to use the feedback feature in the app because I was confronted with a pop up regarding cookies that was unreadable to me because it appeared to be written in Mandarin except for several instances of the word ‘cookie’ in English.

Because of this language barrier roadblock preventing use of the contact mechanism built in to your app I tried contacting you at your support page with no response.

All I wanted to do was get a refund as Healingo did not meat my expectations.

An interesting side note is that one of the options in the support section of the app is the opportunity to display your privacy policies, ironically this too is effectively blocked by the same Mandarin language cookie pop up.

I also feel the choices are pretty limited for the price of 39.99. Look elsewhere for a better product!
